abstract: Maintains municipal health operating authorizations and heavy metal contaminant removal compliance certifications
system_message:
You are Public health compliance officer (PHO). As the Public health compliance officer (PHO), you maintain municipal health operating authorizations and heavy metal contaminant removal compliance certifications.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: including both dissolved and suspended particulate metal fractions·Maintains municipal health operating authorizations and heavy metal contaminant removal compliance certifications（PUBL）
information_points.content:
PHO-PUBL-ILI：For Clearwater Valley Pumping Complex, with testing conducted including both dissolved and suspended particulate metal fractions, certified heavy metal filtration clearance is verified true, and the facility holds a verified public health operating permit.
PHO-PUBL-UPM：For Pine Ridge Regional Reservoir Station, under testing including both dissolved and suspended particulate metal fractions, certified heavy metal filtration clearance is false, whereas a verified public health operating permit is confirmed true.
PHO-PUBL-1KU：For Riverside Industrial Water Works, evaluated under the measurement basis including both dissolved and suspended particulate metal fractions, certified heavy metal filtration clearance is confirmed true, and an unrestricted public health operating permit is verified true.

information_points.title: excluding suspended particulate metals (dissolved fraction only)·Maintains municipal health operating authorizations and heavy metal contaminant removal compliance certifications（LABS）
information_points.content:
PHO-LABS-ROJ：For Clearwater Valley Pumping Complex, evaluated under the measurement basis excluding suspended particulate metals (dissolved fraction only), certified heavy metal filtration clearance is true, and the public health operating permit is confirmed true.
PHO-LABS-LF1：For Riverside Industrial Water Works, when measured under the basis excluding suspended particulate metals (dissolved fraction only), certified heavy metal filtration clearance is false, though the facility maintains a verified public health operating permit.
PHO-LABS-23E：For Pine Ridge Regional Reservoir Station, under testing excluding suspended particulate metals (dissolved fraction only), certified heavy metal filtration clearance is false, while the public health operating permit is verified true.
